title: Ukraine and Russia Eye New Peace Talks as Zelensky Sets Conditions
detail: Reports say Ukraine and Russia are weighing new peace talks, with First Lady Melania Trump reportedly involved in a mission tied to the effort. Zelensky has set conditions for ending the war, and steep obstacles remain. Based on a single aggregated headline; details unverified.

title: Explosions Rock Russian Petrochemical Plant After Ukrainian Drone Strike
detail: Reports say explosions rocked a Russian petrochemical plant hit by a Ukrainian drone strike. Based on a single aggregated headline; plant name and location not confirmed.

title: Ukraine Says Starlink Service Restored as Attacks Continue in Russia and Ukraine
detail: Ukraine says Starlink service has been restored as attacks continue on both sides of the border.
